_comment: Combat rules and MONSTER data. Frame counts are simulation ticks (60 per second). Numbers are placeholders to tune by feel. MONSTER STRENGTH is meant to track the player: level-1 monsters are balanced against the starter gear (about ATK 13.5, DEF 92, HP 112; HP SCALE 100 since 2026-11-13: every HP and ATK number in data, players and monsters alike, was divided by 10 so a starter card shows 100 HP; DEF stays because the DEF rule DEF/(DEF+defense_constant) has no HP unit): a grunt dies in about 3 combos, a charger in about 5, a brute in about 11 heavy hits, and a monster light hit takes about 4-6% of the player's HP, a heavy or slam about 11-16%. enemy_level_scaling = how much a monster grows per level above 1, so a stage for better gear just sets a higher level on its spawns (map enemy_spawns[].level). The player's weapons (fists, sword, dagger, spear, hammer and their moves) are in weapons.json. A move chains into on_light / on_heavy when that button was pressed during the move and the active frames are over. invuln_from/invuln_to (inclusive/exclusive, in move frames) make the fighter untouchable during that part of the move. telegraph = the client warns the player during the wind-up. advance = forward rush speed during the swing.
_coop_comment: M2 prototype, enabled only for explicit 2-4 player sessions. ADR HP scaling; revive/bleedout values are initial test tuning pending playtest. Stand still near a downed ally to revive; no extra button/codec bit is needed.
_ranged_comment: RANGED ATTACKS (logic/projectiles.gd). A move fires through its 'spawns' list: {projectile: id | area: id | blink: meters, frame: move frame (default = its startup, the strike), offset: [forward, up, side (+ = the shooter's right)] from the feet in meters, measured on the clip's release frame (2026-10-12: archer arrow tip at frame 34 of shoot / 44 of volley, mage crystal at frame 30 of cast, where the staff has thrust forward), angle: degrees off the facing}. A move with spawns hits only through them (melee: true to also swing). Damage, guard, dodge and effects are the melee rules with the move's power. PROJECTILES: look = how the client draws it (arrow, bolt), speed m/s, range m it flies, radius m, pierce = extra targets it passes through, gravity m/s2 down and lift = m/s up at release (an arrow's slight arc), homing = degrees per second it turns toward its target (0 = none, weak = 30-60), walls = stops at walls and the floor, aim_cone = it aims straight at the nearest opponent within this many degrees of the facing (free aim; otherwise straight ahead). It can be guarded from the front (unless the move ignores_guard) and i-frames let it fly through. AREAS: a circle marked on the ground at the opponent the caster faces (within range and aim_cone), radius m, delay = ticks of warning before it goes off (at least 20; the circle fills up meanwhile), active = ticks it hurts (each opponent once), height m it reaches up, guardable (false: step out or dodge).
_goblin_comment: The goblin's own twin-dagger moves (not the player's dagger set), timed to the animator's clips (art/animations/goblin.json): goblin_jab = attack_1 (marks 0.20/0.43/0.90 s; 10/4/16 frames, so the clip plays about 1.8x fast), goblin_lunge = attack_2 (marks 0.60/0.92/1.80 s; 30/10/34 frames = 0.5 s telegraphed wind-up). Both move only as the clips do (advance 0, Boss 2026-10-10: a realistic lunge): the lunge's hit box sits 0.3 m further out to match the clip's pounce, so it lands from the same striking spot as the jab. body_height 0.98 = it is hit only where its body is. flee_hp/flee_ticks: below 30% health it runs away for 1.25 s, once, then comes back. The Goblin Chief (the journey boss) is the same model and clips 1.3x bigger and darker (model_tint), with its own moves scaled to its reach. MOVESPD -12 (3.3 m/s) keeps the run clip's feet planted (authored for 2.44 m/s, played 0.6-1.4x).
_monster_comment: A monster may use any weapon style from weapons.json (the grunt uses fists, so it also has the fists skill: it sometimes works itself into a Rage). Monster stamina is only used by that skill. skill_chance (percent) = how often its AI uses the style's special skill instead of its normal attack. Monsters' buffs and debuffs are the same effects the player uses (effects.json); EFFECT_RES makes a monster hard to stun, shock or poison. model (optional) = a .glb facing +Z, feet at the bottom; it is scaled so its full bounds (hats, horns, crowns included) are model_height meters, while body_height is the body the rules hit; an untextured model is tinted like the capsule (state colors), a textured one keeps its texture and the state tints multiply it; without one the monster is a capsule. animations (optional) = its animation set .glb (idle, run, attack_1, attack_2, hit, death + a .json of windup_end/strike_end/length marks next to it); if that file is missing the model's own clips are used, and with none the model is static. clips = which clip each of its moves plays (default attack_1); standin_clips (optional) = what to play while the set does not have that clip yet (every goblin variant has its own clips since 2026-10-12). nock_mesh = a mesh of the model shown only while a firing move winds up (the archer's arrow on the string). ai.retreat_ticks = after each attack it backs off from the player this long (hit and run).

mummy.role: Mummy: the Pyramid's basic melee undead (the goblin's twin). It shambles straight in and claws; it glows before a telegraphed grave grasp that can curse you (DEF and healing down). Undead: it never hops back or flees. Dodge the grasp.
mummy._design: Boss2026-10-21: base combat stats1.5x normal Goblin at the same level. HP 45/ATK 15/DEF 45 (HP SCALE 100: /10 on 2026-11-13); MOVESPD32 gives1.32x base walk versus Goblin0.88x (=1.5x). ATKSPD50 gives1.5x move-frame speed;AI cooldowns40–73ticks from Goblin60–110 divided by1.5 (integer rounding). Zero CRIRATE/poise stay zero. combat-designer 2026-11-17: its own moves mirror the goblin's one to one (mummy_strike = goblin_jab frames/power, mummy_grasp = goblin_lunge frames/power/cooldown with curse 50% instead of wound 50%), so the ATKSPD 50 makes it swing 1.5x as fast as the goblin, as the Boss ruled. skill_chance 25 like the goblin. No retreat/flee (undead identity; the goblin's hop-back and flee are dropped). model = the old stand-in until the new model (character-artist, same path or mummy_base) lands; the first existing entry of looks wins. combat-designer 2026-11-19 (Boss: 'the mummies hit far too softly'): round 1 HP 45 -> 11, ATK 15 -> 45 (3x); ROUND 2 the same day (Boss/PO: about 2x the original damage, HP near the original): HP 36, ATK 30 (2x, 2.9x the goblin's 10.5); the grasp may also bleed (30%, 2 s). Animator/PO request the same day: mummy_strike startup 10 -> 18 (the clip's 0.4 s wind-up was invisible at 0.11 s) and MOVESPD 32 -> 12 (4.26 m/s, a shamble; the run plays inside the 0.6-1.4x clamp with run_clip_speed 1.539, tests/test_monster_rig.gd passes). The journey's wave powers were re-tuned to ~70% for the zone-level squad (data/journeys/mummy_waves.json _tuning_hard_hits).

mummy_knight.role: Mummy Knight: a tomb guard in a bronze helm, round shield on the left arm, a heavy khopesh in the right (the goblin knight's twin). Slow and armoured, poise 140: light hits do not stagger it; it never backs off. Each blow is wound up ('!'): a wide khopesh cleave, and a shield bash that steps forward and can stun. Dodge through or step back, then punish the recovery.
mummy_knight._design: combat-designer 2026-11-17: the goblin knight x1.5 on HP/ATK/DEF (the mummy/goblin zone step, Boss 2026-10-21): HP 165 / ATK 18 / DEF 120; poise 140 and EFFECT_RES 30 unchanged; MOVESPD -48 -> -36 (+12 like the archer twin, 2.4 m/s vs 1.98). Moves mirror one to one: cleave = goblin_knight_cleave frames/power 1.6; the bash replaces the overhead (34/6/40 frames vs 42/5/46, power 2.4 vs 3.0, advance 8, stun 35% instead of sunder 100%, cooldown 360). Stand-in model = the mummy mesh tinted bronze until art/monsters/mummy_knight/mummy_knight.glb lands (looks). combat-designer 2026-11-19 (Boss: hits ~3x harder): round 1 HP 165 -> 41, ATK 18 -> 56; ROUND 2 (about 2x the original damage, HP near the original): HP 140, ATK 36; the bash also sunders (DEF -40%, 60%).

mummy_mage.role: Mummy Mage: a bandaged priest with a scarab staff (the goblin mage's twin). Keeps away, throws slow homing scarab bolts and marks the ground where you stand with a curse circle: it fills, then bursts and curses (DEF and healing down). Keep moving; it dissolves into sand and reappears behind when you reach it.
mummy_mage._design: combat-designer 2026-11-17: the goblin mage x1.5 on HP/ATK/DEF: HP 36 / ATK 16.5 / DEF 38; EFFECT_RES 20 and the whole AI (keep 7.5, retreat 4.5, escape blink 2.6 m every 360 ticks, cooldowns 110-170, skill 45) unchanged; MOVESPD -18 -> -6 (+12 like the archer twin). Moves mirror one to one: scarab bolt = goblin_mage_bolt (projectile mummy_scarab = goblin_bolt numbers), curse circle = goblin_mage_hex (area mummy_curse = goblin_hex numbers) with curse 70% instead of slow 70%, sand step = goblin_mage_blink. The client draws them with the goblin's bolt/hex_circle looks until sand looks exist (client/projectile_view.gd LOOKS). A real blink clip needs a new keyframed clip (docs/art/monster_requests/mummy_mage.md): Boss decision. combat-designer 2026-11-19 (Boss: hits ~3x harder): round 1 HP 36 -> 9, ATK 16.5 -> 50; ROUND 2: HP 32, ATK 33; the curse circle also exhausts (stamina regen -60%, 50%); DEBUFF_ACC 10 so its debuffs still land through tier-1 rings.

mummy_boss.role: Mummy Pharaoh: the Pyramid's boss (the Goblin Chief's twin), crowned, 2.6 m, a gold khopesh. It stands its ground: a two-cut khopesh combo whose second cut throws a short sand crescent that passes through up to three fighters, and a telegraphed sand-curse nova all around it (DODGE out or through it). Its cuts can make you BLEED; the nova curses (DEF and healing down) and WOUNDS (healing -60%). It cannot be stunned, shocked, put to sleep, staggered or knocked away (boss rule), but slows, sunders, burns and poisons still work on it.
mummy_boss._design: combat-designer 2026-11-17: the Goblin Chief x1.5 on HP/ATK/DEF: HP 225 / ATK 18.8 / DEF 90; poise 60 and EFFECT_RES 30 unchanged; MOVESPD -15 -> -3 (+12 like the archer twin). Moves mirror the Chief's two: combo (light) = melee cut + sand crescent at frame 26, power 0.55 each (1.1 if both land vs the Chief's jab 0.8; the crescent misses a fighter who steps aside), nova (special) = a 5 x 5 m box on itself, power 1.5 vs the lunge's 2.1 because it can hit the whole squad, curse 70% vs wound 70%, cooldown 300 like the lunge. skill_chance 35, attack_range 2.9 (Chief 2.7). The journey adds boss hp_mult/poise_mult on top. Stand-in = the mummy mesh tinted gold until art/monsters/mummy_boss/mummy_boss.glb lands (looks). combat-designer 2026-11-19 (Boss: hits ~3x harder, statuses on the player, boss resistance rule): round 1 HP 225 -> 100, ATK 18.8 -> 72; ROUND 2: HP 200, ATK 40 (2.1x); CTRL_RES 100 (Boss rule: every boss but the goblins; no stun/shock/sleep/stagger/knockback/launch), no DEBUFF_RES/DOT_RES (the players' debuff builds must work on bosses); DEBUFF_ACC 15 + DOT_ACC 15 so its statuses stay meaningful through ring EFFECT_RES (tier 1 ~17-21). Combo: bleed 30% (3 s); nova: curse 70% + wound 50%. The old role line about calling an archer and a mage at low health was stale (no such summon exists in wave mode). combat-designer 2026-11-22 round 2 (Boss: both wave-9 bosses act 3x faster, HP x2): every move a third of its value then (combo 14/5/28 -> 5/2/9 with the crescent at frame 26 -> 9, the same point of the clip's second cut; nova 40/5/40 -> 20/2/13, its wind-up held at the loader's 20-tick minimum warning, cooldown 300 -> 100), AI rest 70-120 -> 23-40, opening_cooldown 10 (was the fixed 30), runs in from beyond 5 m (as the Warlock); clips play ~3x via the view's phase stretch. HP 200 -> 400 (x2, Boss order; NOT re-tuned).

mummy_high_wizard.role: Mummy High Wizard: the BIG boss of the Pyramid (3.4 m pharaoh-mage with a serpent staff), fought together with the Mummy Pharaoh (mummy_boss) in the wave-9 finale; the escorts rise from summoning circles as it arrives. It holds its ground at range and never stops casting: homing golden BOLTS, a purple-gold CURSE CIRCLE under a fighter (fills, then bursts: curse = DEF and healing down), a STARFALL where three falling-star marks chase the nearest fighter one after another, and when anyone steps within 4 m a SANDSTORM whirls around it, hurling everyone in 3 m away, slowing and weakening them. Its statuses: bolts may weaken or bleed, the curse circle curses and EXHAUSTS (stamina regen down), falling stars BURN and may SHOCK (cannot move). Every big blow is marked on the ground first: step out of the circles, never stand next to it. It cannot be stunned, shocked, put to sleep, staggered or knocked away (boss rule); debuffs and DoTs still work on it.
mummy_high_wizard._design: combat-designer 2026-11-18 (Boss 2026-11-17: the boss pair; VERY powerful, spectacular, brutal; Boss 2026-11-18 option a: ai.skills). Four moves: light = mummy_hw_bolt (clip cast, homing projectile hw_bolt), ai.skills = mummy_hw_starfall (clip starfall, cooldown 480, 35% when ready) then mummy_hw_curse (clip cast_aoe, cooldown 240, 45% when ready), escape = heavy mummy_hw_sandstorm (clip sandstorm, escape_range 4.0, every 300 ticks). The summon clip/VFX is visual only (client/monster_vfx.gd, as its wave arrives). Stats vs the Pharaoh (HP 225 / ATK 18.8 / DEF 90): HP 300, ATK 20, DEF 80, poise 120, EFFECT_RES 40, MOVESPD -24 (slow and huge); retreat_range 0 = it never backs away. Timings follow art/animations/monster_clips_wizard_boss.json marks (bolt windup 0.95 s -> 40, curse 1.75 s -> 72, starfall 2.3 s -> 96, sandstorm 1.875 s -> 70). Numbers measured with tools/balance/class_sim.gd, see data/journeys/mummy_waves.json _tuning_boss_pair. combat-designer 2026-11-19 (Boss: hits ~3x harder, statuses on the player, boss resistance rule): round 1 HP 300 -> 135, ATK 20 -> 77; ROUND 2: HP 270, ATK 42 (2.1x, the hardest hitter of the family); CTRL_RES 100 (no stun/shock/sleep/stagger/knockback/launch); NO DEBUFF_RES/DOT_RES on purpose: its EFFECT_RES 40 already halves the players' debuff chances, more would make debuff builds useless on the zone boss and there is no measured balance need (the win rate is tuned by power). DEBUFF_ACC 20, DOT_ACC 15, CTRL_ACC 5. Statuses: bolt weaken 15% + bleed 10% (2 s, small chances on a frequent move), curse circle curse 70% + exhaust 60%, starfall burn 40% (1.5 s, each mark) + shock 20% (the only control: telegraphed 0.9 s, chance < 100, the 2 s post-control immunity stays), sandstorm slow 60% + weaken 40% (no control: it already hurls). Effective chances vs a typical card in data/journeys/mummy_waves.json _tuning_hard_hits. combat-designer 2026-11-22 (Boss: bosses ~3x faster; it showed the Warlock's slowness): moves a third (bolt 40/4/40 -> 14/2/14, curse 72/6/54 -> 24/2/18 cd 240 -> 80, starfall 96/30/60 -> 32/10/20 cd 480 -> 160 with marks at 32/37/42, sandstorm 70/48/40 -> 24/16/14 every 300 -> 100), areas hw_curse delay 66 -> 22 and hw_star 54 -> 20 (the loader's minimum warning), AI rest 100-150 -> 33-50, opening_cooldown 10; target_priority ranged_first. HP/ATK unchanged (not re-tuned). combat-designer 2026-11-22 round 2 (Boss: both wave-9 bosses 3x faster, HP x2): its timings already got the 3x above (not compounded); HP 270 -> 540 (x2, Boss order; NOT re-tuned).

dummy_grunt.role: Grunt: walks up and jabs. Beat it with combos.

brute.role: Brute: slow, tough, raises its arms before a huge slam. DODGE the slam.

charger.role: Charger: crouches, then rushes in a straight line. GUARD it or step out of the lane.

goblin.role: Goblin: small, twitchy, comes in packs. Darts in, stabs, hops back; glows before a leaping lunge. Catch it as it lands.

goblin_chief.role: Goblin Chief: crowned, nearly twice a goblin's size, twin cleavers. It stands its ground: a quick chop and a telegraphed leaping lunge with long reach; it shrugs off light hits. DODGE the lunge.

goblin_archer.role: Goblin Archer: hangs back and shoots. It draws before each arrow (no '!': only the 3-arrow volley warns, Boss 2026-10-10); sidestep or guard it, then close in: it backs away but cannot fight up close.

goblin_mage.role: Goblin Mage: keeps away, throws slow homing bolts and marks the ground where you stand: the circle fills, then bursts. Keep moving; it blinks away when you reach it.

goblin_knight.role: Goblin Knight: slow, armored, a greatsword taller than itself held ONE-HANDED (the goblin's fists can never meet on one hilt; the off-hand swings free). It never retreats or flees: a heavy, deliberate advance that closes the distance by never backing off, poise 140 so light hits do not stagger it. Each swing is wound up a long time ('!'): the side cleave, and an overhead that steps forward as it falls (advance) so it still catches a player who stands still. Dodge through a swing or step back, then hit it while it recovers.
goblin_knight._design: One-handed grip is what the animator's clips do now (tools/blender/goblin_family_clips.py: 'one hilt, so the greatsword is swung one-handed, grip_offhand stays unused'); the run clip is already a heavy armoured stomp with the blade dragged behind. No skeleton/arm change. No two-hand assumptions live in data: move ids (cleave/overhead) and VFX keys (vfx.json windup/swing/<move>) are grip-neutral. SPEED: MOVESPD -48 => 3.8 * 0.52 = 1.98 m/s, about 59% of a goblin's 3.34 m/s (goblin MOVESPD -12). run_clip_speed 1.55: the client plays the walk clip at speed / (run_clip_speed * model_fit); knight model_fit ~= 1.28, so 1.55 * 1.28 = 1.98 m/s reference => the heavy stomp plays at ~1.0x (its authored deliberate cadence) at the knight's own slow speed, instead of being pinned near the 0.6x clamp floor of the shared 2.44 reference (which caps how slow a monster can be shown).

orc_grunt.role: Orc Grunt: the Orc Camp's basic melee brute with a butcher's cleaver (the goblin's counterpart). It charges straight in and chops; it winds up ('!') a lunging two-step cleave that can WOUND you (healing down). It never hops back.

orc_warlock.role: Orc Warlock: the BOSS of the Orc Camp, a 3.2 m hooded, horned orc warlord in a purple war-robe with sword and shield. It marches in with a heavy regal stride and fights up close: a sweeping CLEAVE that makes you bleed; the SKYFALL, a telegraphed leap that crashes down on you (sunder, may stun); the CATACLYSM, a spinning rise into the air that drives the sword into the ground and breaks everything around it (weaken, wound, bleed); and the BULWARK, a shield slam into a huge guard stance (it cannot be hurt for a moment, its defence rises, and the slam exhausts and weakens whoever stands in front). It cannot be stunned, shocked, put to sleep, staggered or knocked away (boss rule); debuffs and DoTs still work on it.

HP 300 -> 1500 (x5, Boss order; NOT re-tuned: the Boss judges balance by playing).
